- WikiTok app - TikTok-style Wikipedia article browser

- Provider: `LikedArticlesProvider` wraps the app (uses localStorage for "likedArticles")

- Data fetching: `useWikiArticles` fetches from Wikipedia API (e.g. `https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?...`)
